clients.aboutPage.acciolyDescription: Ecologist with a doctorate in social ecology and a master’s in geography. Identifies environmental asset opportunities, analyses data and coordinates solid waste and circular economy projects.
clients.aboutPage.bertocheDescription: Systems analyst. Manages the development of BVRio’s platforms and systems and links the teams that need IT products with the technical team.
clients.aboutPage.de2Focus: An applied methodological platform for indicators and MRV of circular-economy and environmental-recovery initiatives.
clients.aboutPage.doctorDescription: Leads the methodological design, the matrix of comparable indicators and the monitoring, reporting and verification (MRV) criteria.
clients.aboutPage.factDurationValue: 24 months (the second year depends on the scholarships being renewed)
clients.aboutPage.factInstitutionValue: Instituto BVRio, a non-profit organisation founded in 2011
clients.aboutPage.factPilotValue: The Pescando Resíduos programme, which has paid artisanal fishers for the traceable removal of waste since 2021
clients.aboutPage.fundingBody: Scholarships granted for up to 12 months, 40 hours a week; the work plan covers 24 months, and the second year depends on renewal.
clients.aboutPage.introduction: Portal Guanabara grows out of Instituto BVRio’s applied research with FAPERJ scholarships: to bring together, in one place, who studies and who acts for Guanabara Bay, with comparable data and indicators.
clients.aboutPage.me2Focus: Applied research focused on organising data and indicators, a digital/web platform prototype and a pilot application to Pescando Resíduos.
clients.aboutPage.mirandaDescription: Environmental science student at UFF. Develops Circular Action Programmes for companies with the KOLEKT app.
clients.aboutPage.partnerCoopromar: fishers’ cooperative: fieldwork in the territory and co-production of data
clients.aboutPage.partnerInea: institutional dialogue and use of the results
clients.aboutPage.partnerOgyre: traceability and funding of the operations
clients.aboutPage.projectName: Logística reversa costeira e carbono azul: protocolos inovadores para economia circular inclusiva em manguezais da Baía de Guanabara
clients.aboutPage.projectObjective: To generate applied knowledge and technical-scientific protocols that improve coastal reverse logistics in the urban mangroves of Guanabara Bay — bringing together traceable operational data, territorial prioritisation, technology trials and measurable environmental evidence — and to turn an operation that already works into a replicable basis for other coastal territories.
clients.aboutPage.studentDescription: Organises the data and the indicators, builds this portal and applies the indicator matrix to Pescando Resíduos.
clients.aboutPage.succarDescription: Engineer with a master’s in city governance. Leads project management and the work to increase waste circularity in Brazil.
clients.aboutPage.title: About us
clients.app.footer: Public information on waste in Guanabara Bay, from BVRio’s mapping of initiatives and studies.
